$comment: DELETE /v1.0/subscriptions/{id}, 204 with no body. Read from the Graph v1.0 reference. The action a subscription trigger's `stop` names.
title: Outlook subscription removal
description: Delete a change-notification subscription. The host's subscription machinery calls this when a trigger is removed.
$sideEffectsComment: Deleting a subscription that is already gone answers 404 rather than deleting anything else. A retry cannot compound.

outputShape.description: Which estate this ran against. Graph answers 204 with no body, so this is the only thing published.
